Payload fixtures with synthetic ids (account `123456789012`, `EXAMPLE` suffixes). `harness_before_tool_call` and `gateway_request` follow findings Appendix A; the rest are hand-built from the Harness hook table, the demo handler and the findings' description of a truncated result. `gateway_response_streaming` is `gateway_response` with `isStreamingResponse` true. `gateway_request_notification` and `gateway_response_notification` are a `notifications/initialized` pair as a real Gateway sent them: the request body has no `id` and no `params`, and the response has no `body`.
